title: Redesign the manager page: board counts, worktrees, recent activity, token trend
notes: The manager page looks like a bare terminal page and is mostly empty. Improve its UI so it reads like an app, not a terminal. Add: (1) board counts on each project row (doing / review / todo). (4) Recent activity: latest card moves and merges across all projects, newest first. (5) Token trend: small per-day bars for the week beside the 5h/week/all columns. Also show each project's worktrees with dirty state, and let a worktree be deleted from there. Not wanted for now: a 'needs you' column or an 'in flight' list.
